name: custody-record
title: Equipment custody record
for_each: select c.id,a.tag||' - '||p.name name from custody c join assets a on a.id=c.asset_id join people p on p.id=c.person_id

sections.title: Recorded handover and return
sections.note: An operator record, not a signed acknowledgement.

name: stocktake-pack
title: Physical stocktake record
for_each: select id,tag name from assets where state<>'disposed'

sections.title: Observations
sections.sql: select seen_on,site,evidence,actor from observations where asset_id=$1 order by seen_on desc

name: disposal-record
title: Disposal evidence record
for_each: select d.id,a.tag name from disposals d join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id

sections.title: Operator-confirmed evidence
sections.note: This record does not certify sanitisation. Verify the evidence itself.
sections.sql: select a.tag,a.serial,d.disposed_on,d.method,d.evidence,d.approved_by,d.retention_review from disposals d join assets a on a.id=d.asset_id where d.id=$1
